notable_absence.finding: This overview page names only Couchbase buckets' storage-engine choice and never mentions Ephemeral buckets or the bucket-type axis at all, even though the very next pages in this batch (create-bucket.md, edit-bucket.md) are built entirely around the Couchbase/Ephemeral distinction. A reader landing on this page alone would not learn a second bucket type exists.

cross_component_finding: The page states a hard cluster-wide cap - 'A maximum of 30 buckets can be created per cluster' - repeated verbatim as a Prerequisite on create-bucket.md ('Your cluster must have less than 30 buckets'), so the same numeric limit is corroborated across two pages in this batch rather than appearing once.
